title: Triangulated strict scalar extension
statement: For l, E, L, ι and X satisfying the hypotheses of [def-sf-integral-finite-extension-core], the functor (integralScalarExtensionOfUniverses l E L ι X) admits a CommShift over ℤ and is IsTriangulated.

proof.text: Obtain a shift c and exactness of Qh ⋙ T from the precomposition existence theorem. Apply descent for precisely this shift, and package c with exactness of T.

      (integralScalarExtensionOfUniverses l E L ι X).IsTriangulated
